WITH all_executions AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount > 0
),
per_order_avg AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount
  FROM all_executions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as first_bench_value
  FROM per_order_avg
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT poa.ordersmark, poa.avg_fillcount, (poa.avg_fillcount - fb.first_bench_value) as first_excess
  FROM per_order_avg poa
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark fb
  WHERE poa.avg_fillcount > fb.first_bench_value
),
second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as second_bench_value
  FROM first_filter
),
final_filter AS (
  SELECT ff.avg_fillcount, ff.first_excess, (ff.avg_fillcount - sb.second_bench_value) as second_excess
  FROM first_filter ff
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb
  WHERE ff.avg_fillcount > sb.second_bench_value
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_per_order_fill_quantity, AVG(first_excess) as avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) as avg_second_excess
FROM final_filter;
